report.evidence_requirement_verbatim: two mechanically independent signals per load-bearing claim (rules/common/single-signal-verification.md); every claim carries source lineage (resolved URL + fetch timestamp + sha256 of the fetched bytes), a Sherman-Kent confidence band, and a named independent verification path (_USER-PROMPTS.md:10717); a conclusion counts as challenged only if a recorded query, its result set and a verdict exist; a hedging phrase in the prose does not count and the audit must state that rule

classification_rule.challenged: CHALLENGED requires a claim-bound recorded query or executable procedure, its recorded observed result set, and a bound verdict. Keyword mentions do not fill a missing field.
classification_rule.unchallenged: Missing any triad member is UNCHALLENGED. A verdict-only row, caveat, hedge, or generic execution/result keyword does not fill a missing query or result set.
classification_rule.hedging_phrase_rule: A hedging phrase in the prose does not count as a challenge.
classification_rule.use_versus_mention_rule: Mentioning execution/result words is not enough; the record must identify the procedure, observed outcomes, and claim-bound verdict.

answer.plain_language: 12 of 12 pinned canonical conclusions (100%) have a recorded counterevidence triad under the strict classifier. The never-challenged list is empty. Registry narrative source_probe/verifier_probe strings were not promoted.
